headline: Brazil foreign direct investment slips to $9.1bn in October
summary: Brazil drew a net $9.1 billion in foreign direct investment in October, down from September, with about two-thirds consisting of locally reinvested profits.
why: Foreign direct investment inflows reflect international confidence in an economy and provide capital for domestic currency stability and growth.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Lower net FDI inflows indicate a reduction in incoming cross-border capital for the period.
